title: Finite-Approximate Solvability of Linear Operator Equations
summary: We introduce and study the finite-approximate solvability of operator equations \(Lu = h\) in a Hilbert space setting, where a bounded operator \(L \colon U \to H\) is paired with a finite-dimensional constraint operator \(π\colon H \to H_0\). The objective is to match exactly the prescribed component \(πh\) while approximating the remainder. We prove that the problem of finding \(u\) such that \(\|Lu - h\| 0\) if and only if \(αT_α^{-1}h \to 0\) as \(α\to 0^+\). We further show that dropping any of the structural assumptions on \(L\), \(Γ\), or \(π\) leads to a failure of the equivalence.…
